title: Info Line Component
description: Compact 'icon + value' line for entity cards (phone, email, truck, container…). Abstract: YAML assembles the value string, the component only renders it. An empty value renders nothing, so optional lines can be declared unconditionally.

name.description: Unique name identifier for the info line

icon.description: Icon class name (tabler-* or FontAwesome), e.g. tabler-phone, tabler-mail, tabler-truck, tabler-container

iconColor.description: Icon color: theme path (primary, text.secondary) or CSS color. Default text.secondary

value.description: The text to render, assembled in YAML, e.g. '{{ container.number }} • {{ container.size }}'. Empty → the line is not rendered

href.description: Renders the value as a link: tel:{{ … }}, mailto:{{ … }}, or any URL

onClick.description: Actions to execute on click (alternative to href); makes the line clickable

truncate.description: Single line with ellipsis; the tooltip defaults to the full value

tooltip.description: Explicit tooltip; overrides the truncate default

variant.description: chip renders a bordered rounded container (equipment/container chips)
